about: Test tiers for test/ci.js. baseline: a quick smoke set on every PR into a release branch or main (about 5 min), plus the suites a PR turns on (see suites; their long tests only with soak); keep it to tests under ~20 s that cover something core. integration: baseline plus everything else, on the pull request that takes a release branch into main and on demand from the Actions tab (about an hour). kind actions = module for test/run.js; node = standalone script. timeout in seconds (default 300). New tests not listed here run in integration unless they carry a // @ci comment.

soak.about: opt-in: the long tests (over about 75 s in CI) of every suite. Naming a suite runs its tests without these; add soak to the line to run them too (CI suites: village, soak). all includes them. Integration always runs them.

jobs.about: villager professions and the supply chains: foresters, toolsmiths, miners, builders, furniture makers, tools and wear

farming.about: farmers, farmland, shepherds and sheep, food

village.about: village life: sizes and kits, paths, chests and beds, deaths, golems, explorers and tents, jobsites, the village log, economy

world.about: world generation, rivers, maps and auto maps, cartographers, mobs and night spawning, boats and horses

items.about: inventory, crafting, creative mode, dropped items and saves, durability, held items, block variants

ui.about: screens and input: debug screen and its views, villager screens and hover cards, overlays, Escape and mouse release, title screen
